title: Dynamic delivery timer: 10 PM ET cutoff, 22:01–12:00 ET HIT window, Thu-22:00 weekend lock
body:
Replaces the legacy 2 PM ET cutoff and 00:00–12:00 ET HIT window with a real-time, ET-driven delivery engine: **22:00 ET standard cutoff**, **22:01 → 12:00 ET HIT window** (exclusive at 12:00), and a **weekend lock** (Thu ≥ 22:00 / Fri / Sat / Sun → ship Monday). A 1-second countdown UI is surfaced on every order page, with client and server validation kept in sync.

### Engine — `src/lib/delivery/`
- `timezone.ts` — `nowET`, `etPartsOf`, `fromET`, `addDaysET`. Intl-based, DST-safe, no new deps (luxon was evaluated; ~70 KB not worth it given existing Intl pattern).
- `cutoffs.ts` — `STANDARD_CUTOFF` 22:00, `HIT_OPEN` 22:01, `HIT_CLOSE` 12:00, `BLACKOUT_DATES`.
- `engine.ts` — `getDeliveryEstimate({ nowET, isHitSelected }) → { state, shipDate, deliveryDate, message, cutoffTime, hitWindowOpen, hitAvailable, weekendLock }`. Weekend-locked orders skip Friday and ship the next non-blackout Monday; HIT pre-noon ships same business day, HIT 22:01–23:59 ships next business day.
- `messages.ts` — `standardLine`, `hitOfferLine`, `hitSelectedLine`, `weekendLockLine`, `formatCountdown`.

### React layer
- `useDeliveryCountdown` — 1 s `setInterval`, `visibilitychange` resync (no drift after long backgrounding), recompute on `isHitSelected` flip and on cutoff expiry.
- `DeliveryTimer` — single component, four state branches (`standard` / `hit_available` / `hit_selected` / `weekend_lock`), `default` and `compact` variants. `hit_available` recomputes a HIT-selected estimate so the upsell line shows the actual accelerated delivery date.

### Wired surfaces
- `CartModal` (compact, reflects cart's HIT flag), `Checkout` (full-width, reflects cart, hides "FREE Next-Day Air Shipping" trust line when HIT is on), `Design` and `GoogleAdsBanner` (compact, above each `SameDayHitServiceCard`).

### Validation parity
- `src/lib/sameDayService.ts:isSameDayWindowOpen` now delegates to `isHitAvailable` from the engine — HIT is correctly hidden during the weekend lock (was previously offered Friday morning). Existing cart `reconcileSameDayHitService` therefore auto-clears the flag when the timer crosses 12:00 ET or weekend lock starts.
- `netlify/functions/_shared/sameDayService.cjs:isSameDayWindowOpen` mirrors the engine rules so server-side capture/validation cannot drift from the client.

### Tests
- New `src/lib/delivery/__tests__/engine.test.ts` (38 tests): window edges (00:00 / 11:59 / 12:00 / 21:59 / 22:00 / 22:01 / 23:59), weekend lock (Thu cutoff edge, Fri/Sat/Sun, Mon 00:00 unlock), standard ship + delivery across the week, HIT pre-noon vs. post-22:00, full `getDeliveryEstimate` state matrix, DST spring-forward / fall-back, blackouts.
- `src/lib/__tests__/sameDayService.test.ts` rewritten for the new HIT window and weekend lock.

### Out of scope
Carrier integration, HIT pricing model (60 % + $45 Saturday retained), email template restyling.
